title: Delphi event envelope
description: One line of a mission's event log (specs/005 §2.2; crates/delphi-core/src/event.rs). Readers refuse any other major in `v` and ignore unknown fields. Every `agent.*` event carries the routing fields listed in the `then` branch.

seq.description: Assigned by the log on append.

timestamp.description: Assigned by the log on append.

agent.description: Canonical role ID, never a theme name.

pool_slot.description: The name-pool slot a one-off agent of that role was given (specs/087 §4.3), so a replay shows the same name. A slot, never a theme name; absent for the core roles and for events written before spec 087.

allOf.$comment: specs/083 S3a: a staged note may carry the digest a later dismissal is matched against. Older logs have none.

source_hash.description: SHA-256 (hex) of the note's normalized claim, its evidence (host notes) and its tier. A learn.dropped note is not staged again while this is unchanged, for 90 days (specs/083 §5).
